notes: The intensifying καί of καὶ γὰρ εἴπερ is unrepresented because the ASV writes only For though; rule 65 decides such a καί on the English alone, and a reference comparison reporting it as a disagreement is not a correction.
εἴπερ takes the word introducing its English clause under rule 40, and λεγόμενοι recast as a finite relative clause keeps the supplied relativizer and copula as its own helpers (rules 31, 7).
The two existential εἰσίν are analysed alike, each taking its there plus verb word and heading on the verb (rule 24).
